results.scope: Unchanged original InitWave/SetCircularWave, front normal and connection functions, RayTrace MakeNew/NextByOnce and secondary wave functions with types removed. Uniform index n=1 as in both originals. 36 propagated fronts, all rays and secondary circles/arcs at four radii; five deterministic random seeds for Fresnel. Point2D translation uses exact same primitive arithmetic. No complete random-history or actual AVM2 runtime equivalence claim. Native controls expose repeat/seek/seed and bounded replay.
